fact: Kwara State launched its KW-GIS-based digital land information system, and the KW-IRS chairman says investors and titleholders can now register land, process CofO and obtain building approvals online.
The KW-GIS project manager lists digital parcel mapping and querying and land records integration among the platform's features.
The KW-IRS chairman says the KW-IRS online payment platform is integrated with the new land system, so land and related payments are made online.
